summary: Child conversations with descriptive task names open reliably, and stui offers a manual retry when opening a conversation fails.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rebuild is required.

schema.detail: No database schema or client-v0 wire schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination requirements change.

compatibility.detail: Conversation subscription correlation ids use bounded UUID v7 values while preserving the conversation routing prefix and full target subjects. Existing servers and their 128-byte id limit are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or API interruption is required.

manual.detail: No configuration change is required. Failed conversation opens offer an explicit retry without resending outgoing messages.

recovery.detail: No stored state transition or new rollback step is introduced. Permanent history refusals remain excluded from automatic retry.
